name: global-regex-tool
description: Obsidian plugin: regex find and replace across files, folders, or the entire vault.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d=p.join('dist','global-regex-tool');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of ['main.js','manifest.json','styles.css'])fs.copyFileSync(f,p.join(d,f));console.log('dist/global-regex-tool refreshed');"
